deadline_rule: earlier of tenth actual working day and two calendar weeks

metric_definitions.name: handler_elapsed
metric_definitions.boundary: handler entry to completion including response serialization
metric_definitions.statistic: raw sample per round; not p95/p99

metric_definitions.name: sql_round_trips
metric_definitions.boundary: pgx QueryTracer start count around actual handler/store call; includes count and plan queries

metric_definitions.name: assets_first_explain
metric_definitions.unit: PG execution ms, blocks, SubPlan loops
metric_definitions.boundary: EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS SETTINGS FORMAT JSON of mirrored current first-page SQL
metric_definitions.load: same fixture after ANALYZE; cache temperature not forced

pending_metrics: list/dashboard p95 and p99 under defined mixed load and roles
batch commit p99 and lock wait
WAL bytes and HOT update ratio
login mutex/block profiles and unrelated API latency
DNS billed operations versus actual packets
HTTP operations per host and PG round trips per operation
idle worker queries/s and enqueue-to-claim p95
